column5: The driver/fixture pins are receipt-field echoes: the counter compares receipt fields to CLI pins and never reads instrument bytes, so leg (a) proves declaration, not provenance (narrowing 9; Sentinel independently re-derived the fixture hash).

The page-read act is not required and fixture.patch.* is unbound; per-leg fixtureInputs copies are dead data. The scored receipt has 34 calls and 0/34 divergent copies; the clauses are narrowed to the descriptor/answer/read facts.
The frozen C1 counting command carried the superseded D2 nonce and exited 1; the pointer was corrected to the D3 nonce post-freeze (record fix, no predicate change) and now exits 0 clean 99.

25-mutant sweep: 19 killed, 5 survived, 1 crashed. Four whole-counter escapes on the new grammar rows (setParams.backendNodeId, full answer.files equality, setResult/setError, extra read event) are narrowed as unbound, routed to the next generation.
Two fresh-nonce cold runs: 34/34 legs, 0 failures, 98/99 checks each, only the declaration finding prior-set-complete; the four new legs' facts reproduced identically.
Leg (b) reproduced byte-for-byte: battery 209/0/coverage 99/99, kill power 66/66/0/0/0, selftest 9/9 at D4; only the kill-power results array order varies across runs.
21-lane scan (1816 files): zero sibling capability overlap on accept/showPicker/setFileInputFiles; the four new token forms are uncontested.

Staged WHATWG page byte-identical to the live fetch (cmp exit 0); the whitespace-normalization rule is not on that page, so the law stays acceptance-only and the whitespace leg measures the raw attribute.

At read time the pinned bytes were in no commit (fixed by the freeze commit) and the exit-2 control was static (fixed by the D6 noreceipt-control gate); the selftest's expected identity is taken from the receipt it grades (narrowing 15).
BEFORE 5 mismatches on a clean base worktree, AFTER 0; both do-nothing controls reproduced (exit 1 with 47 findings; exit 2 receipt-unreadable).
Statement (4) pointed at item 1 rather than the headline item and statement (5) was a directionless token test; repaired (row repointed to item 9, D5/D7 gate checks).

The D5 count check was satisfied by the corrections table's own description of it and the item-heading removal passed; D7 scopes the scan to the bullet block and binds item 9's heading, both shown able to fail (inverted 39/40 and removed item 9 each exit 1).
BEFORE/AFTER and both controls PASS on the committed bytes; F3 exit-2 gate added at D6; selftest identity self-reference recorded as a limit.
